theorem lg_target {p : ℕ → ℝ} {r : ℝ} (k : ℕ) (hr : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑n * p n) Filter.atTop (nhds r)) : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(n.choose k) * p n ^ k) Filter.atTop (nhds (r ^ k / ↑k.factorial)) := by
  let f := fun n => ↑(n.choose k) * p n ^ k
  let g := fun n => ↑n * p n
  have h1 : Filter.Tendsto g Filter.atTop (nhds r) := hr
  let hk : ℕ := k
  have h2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(n.choose k) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds (1 / ↑k.factorial)) :=
    by
      rw [← nhds_div, ← nhds_one]
      exact tendsto_div_atTop_nhds_zero_nat k
  have h3 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => p n ^ k) Filter.atTop (nhds (r ^ k)) :=
    by
      apply tendsto_rpow_filter
      exact hr
      exact k
  have h4 : Filter.Tendsto f Filter.atTop (nhds (r ^ k / ↑k.factorial)) :=
    by
      apply tendsto_mul
      exact h2
      exact h3
  exact h4
